boundaryNote: 2021 census communities on the publisher's 2022 boundaries. Population covers private households only; newly created communities may be absent.

population.label: Population in private households
population.note: Excludes collective dwellings. 2021 Census, published on the city's 2022 community boundaries; rounded counts.

children.label: Children under 15
children.note: Share of people in private households; 2021 Census. Excludes collective dwellings.

livingAlone.label: One-person households
livingAlone.note: One-person households divided by all private households; rounded counts.

parkland.label: Mapped parkland
parkland.note: Active Calgary Parks sites used for maintenance operations; not all green space. Definitions differ from Edmonton's parks inventory. Share of the neighbourhood covered by the union of park polygons; overlaps counted once.

parks.label: Park sites overlapping the area
parks.note: Park/site records with more than 1 m² inside the boundary, deduplicated by publisher ID or geometry when no ID is supplied. A site spanning two areas can appear in both.

rail.label: LRT stations in or near the area
rail.note: Distinct named stations inside or within 800 m of the boundary, measured in a straight line. Not a walking distance from a home or a service-frequency measure.
